title: Target Stock Balancer
why: In 2022 Target was left with too much home and apparel stock while some high-demand items still ran short. This tool forecasts every SKU, sets safety stock and reorder points, and flags what to reorder and what to mark down.
problem: A retailer simultaneously experiences stockouts for high-demand products and excess inventory for slow-moving products. Develop an AI inventory intelligence system that analyzes historical demand, seasonality, sales, inventory and supplier lead times to recommend inventory decisions.
data_note: 60 SKUs across 6 departments in one distribution region, 104 weeks of sales, current stock and supplier lead times (sample data).

steps.detail: Weekly sales, seasonality, price, stock on hand and on order, lead times
Lead-time demand + safety stock; EOQ for order size
Weeks of supply above the excess limit
Reorder, expedite, transfer or mark down
AI analyst writes the buyer notes

questions: Which items will stock out first?
How much cash is tied up in excess stock?
What markdown should we take on slow movers?
author: K Bhargav Raju
